harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Persistently disabled IPv4 ICMP-redirect acceptance and source-route acceptance on node1 via /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf (covering all, default, and existing interfaces enp1s0/lo), applied live, then restarted node1 and confirmed the settings survived the reboot with a new boot ID.
actions_performed: Captured pre-change boot_id and sysctl baseline on node1 (accept_redirects/secure_redirects=1, accept_source_route=0)

Applied with sysctl --system and verified live values for all/default, but found per-interface (enp1s0, lo) accept_redirects/secure_redirects still 1 due to OR semantics with pre-existing interface state
Extended the config file with explicit net.ipv4.conf.<iface>.* = 0 lines for enp1s0 and lo, re-applied, and verified all live values (all/default/enp1s0/lo) are 0
Captured pre-restart boot_id, issued a backgrounded sudo systemctl reboot so the ack returned before disconnection
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again and confirmed a new boot_id (1c9de043... vs baseline d9f8550d...), proving an actual restart
Re-verified post-restart that all/default/enp1s0/lo values for accept_redirects, secure_redirects, and accept_source_route remain 0, and that the persistent config file is intact

evidence.requirement: Healthy baseline captured before restart (boot id + current sysctl state)
evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id d9f8550d... and pre-change sysctl values showing accept_redirects/secure_redirects=1 on node1

evidence.requirement: Persistently disable ICMP redirect acceptance and source-routed packet acceptance (IPv4)
evidence.summary: Created /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf, applied via sysctl --system, and after discovering per-interface OR-semantics issue, extended config with explicit enp1s0/lo overrides; verified all/default/enp1s0/lo values are 0 for accept_redirects, secure_redirects, and accept_source_route

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart acknowledgement returned before disconnection
evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id and dispatched a backgrounded sudo systemctl reboot; command returned 'reboot command dispatched' before the node disconnected

evidence.requirement: Poll node1 until command execution available again, proving changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Polling attempts failed with connection timeout/reset while node1 was rebooting, then succeeded with a new boot_id 1c9de043-fbc0-444a-b00d-a9e41504fbcd, differing from the baseline d9f8550d..., proving an actual restart occurred

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of the hardening settings (persistence proof)
evidence.summary: After reboot, sysctl and /proc/sys checks confirm accept_redirects, secure_redirects, and accept_source_route are still 0 for all/default/enp1s0/lo, and the persisted config file /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf is unchanged and present

attempts.summary: Persistently disabled IPv4 ICMP-redirect acceptance and source-route acceptance on node1 via /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf (covering all, default, and existing interfaces enp1s0/lo), applied live, then restarted node1 and confirmed the settings survived the reboot with a new boot ID.
